0.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_COMMITTEE05231_000_001
0.description: Ah, you're back. The people can't get enough of our punch, and it's all I can do to keep mugs filled. I could use your help with the serving again, if you are willing?

1.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_COMMITTEE05231_000_002
1.description: I should mention that a curious lady came by earlier. She spoke passionately about the “spirit of culinary adventure” before gifting us an array of unusual ingredients. Though I was skeptical at first, quite a few guests have enjoyed them in their beverage as an accent.

2.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_COMMITTEE05231_000_003
2.description: So if you have the urge add a little something extra when you serve up a mug, I leave it at your discretion. I would just be glad for the break!

4.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_SYSTEM_000_00
4.description: You bring the pots of punch to a gentle simmer. The enticing aroma attracts someone to the stall!

6.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A1_000_001
6.description: The owner of the Carline Canopy.

7.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A1_000_002
7.description: The proprietor of the Drowned Wench.

10.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A1_000_005
10.description: The lord commander of the Temple Knights.

11.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A1_000_006
11.description: A representative of the East Aldenard Trading Company.

12.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A1_000_007
12.description: The satrap of Radz-at-Han and a diminutive dragon.

13.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A1_000_008
13.description: A world explorer in search of the unknown.

14.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_010
14.description: I thought I smelled a lovely aroma! I've already sampled the new varieties, so may I please have a mug of Gridanian punch? It will be interesting to see how yours compares to the Canopy's house blend.

18.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_012
18.description: That's very tasty indeed! Thank you─you've been a great help.

19.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_013
19.description: The Starlight Stalls have earned quite a stellar reputation─pardon the pun─and there are noticeably more guests from outside Gridania this year.

20.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_014
20.description: From locals to visitors and children to grown-ups, the joy is plain to see on every face. Nothing could bring us stallholders more joy.

21.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_015
21.description: Is this grated chanterelle? Interesting. These fragrant mushrooms are sought after for culinary and medicinal purposes, but I'd never imagined tasting it in a sweet drink.

22.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_016
22.description: While it might require a more mature palate, there's a depth to this punch that's quite enjoyable. I'd be happy to have it again.

23.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MIOUNNE_000_017
23.description: Well, I should return to my duties. When you have a spare moment from your own, do come and relax at the Canopy.

24.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_BADERON_000_020
24.description: I couldn't 'elp but come to see our Lominsan mugs bein' used. An' suffice it to say I'd be much obliged fer some punch too.

28.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_BADERON_000_022
28.description: Aye, the sourness o' the citrus an' the sting o' the spice make fer a right fine drop.

29.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_BADERON_000_023
29.description: We Lominsans ain't so keen on Gridania this time o' year on account o' the freezin' cold, but a nice warm drink makes a world o' difference. This'll keep me goin' as I take in the sights 'neath the snow.

30.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_BADERON_000_024
30.description: Bugger me, that's sweeter than a siren's kiss! Ye put chocolate in 'ere, did ye? An' a whole bleedin' sack o' sugar too, by the taste of it.

31.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_BADERON_000_025
31.description: Still, there's folk as like somethin' a little unusual. An' ye'd be surprised 'ow many seadogs 'ave a sweet tooth, what with sugar bein' used to preserve food on voyages. Aye, I reckon ye might be onto somethin' 'ere.

32.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_BADERON_000_026
32.description: Anyroad, I'd best be on me way. Thanks fer the 'ospitality─next time yer in Limsa, stop by the Wench and I'll return the gesture.

33.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_030
33.description: Miounne invited me to Gridania for the Starlight Celebration, and I couldn't say no. Might I trouble you for a mug of Ul'dahn punch?

37.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_032
37.description: Oh my, what a lovely, full-bodied brew! You definitely didn't skimp on the butter.

38.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_033
38.description: It'd go great with crumpets and would definitely be a hit in Ul'dah. What do you say you come and brew it for me at the Quicksand sometime?

39.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_034
39.description: Hehe, I'm just kiddin'. Long as I've been in the business of servin' food and drink, it's a force of habit to consider the possibilities.

40.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_035
40.description: Well now, what a delicious drink! You've added nopal─cactus flesh─unless I'm mistaken?

41.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_036
41.description: Plenty of folk enjoy nopal roasted in savory dishes, but it works surprisingly well with sweet flavors too. I might have to try adding it to our menu...

42.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_MOMODI_000_037
42.description: Thank you kindly! Whenever you're in Ul'dah, be sure to stop by at the Quicksand, you hear?

43.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_040
43.description: Mulled punch for the guests? What a delightful idea.

44.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_041
44.description: Lest you wonder, my sister Kan-E is busy as is her wont, so I am attending the festivities in her stead. I shall have a Gridanian punch, if you would be so kind.

48.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_043
48.description: How fragrant and delicious! 'Tis a flavor that we can proudly call Gridanian to forestborn and visitors alike.

49.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_044
49.description: Might I ask for two more mugs of the same, for my brother and sister?

50.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_045
50.description: Wonderful, I shall have my attendants deliver these ere they grow cold. My gratitude for the drinks─and for your contribution to the celebration.

52.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_047
52.description: ...So it is simply a confection made to resemble a pom? That is certainly a relief─and for my companions especially. Without further ado, then, I shall give it a taste.

53.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_RAYAOSENNA_000_048
53.description: Well now, that is perfectly delicious! Just...try not to frighten the children overmuch, do you hear?

54.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_AYMERIC_000_050
54.description: What a pleasant surprise to find you here, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. 'Tis a great joy to spread cheer to the children during Starlight season—though, I must confess, this little helper finds himself in need of refreshment. Might I ask for a mug of the local Gridanian punch?

57.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_A6_000_002
57.description: Gridanian punch with a generous dash of birch syrup.

58.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_AYMERIC_000_052
58.description: Ahh, how exquisitely the cinnamon punctuates the sweetness. 'Tis the very taste of respite.

59.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_AYMERIC_000_053
59.description: The Starlight Celebration has its roots in Ishgard. To see the warmth and cheer being spread in all corners of Eorzea makes me feel both proud and grateful.

60.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_AYMERIC_000_054
60.description: Well, now... While this punch tastes quintessentially Gridanian, there is no mistaking the Ishgardian accent. Might this be an acknowledgement of the Starlight Celebration's origins...?

61.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_AYMERIC_000_055
61.description: Yet regardless of the intent, the generous amount of birch syrup is a wonderful touch, and during this most special of seasons, I shall allow myself the indulgence.

62.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_AYMERIC_000_056
62.description: My thanks for the fine drink and company both. By your leave, I shall return to my duties—many children yet await their Starlight gifts, and 'twould not do to keep them!

63.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_060
63.description: Oh my, if it isn't <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Having concluded some business discussions nearby, I thought to drop by the festivities. What a pleasant surprise to find your esteemed self manning a stand.

64.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_061
64.description: You are serving punch to guests, it would seem, and far be it from me to turn it down. I should like a mug of the Ul'dahn variety, if you'd be so kind.

68.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_063
68.description: Ah, what an unmistakably Ul'dahn─and nostalgic─taste! And what a fine example this stall is of “omotenashi,” which, in Hingan, refers to the deep-seated practice of wholeheartedly caring for one's guests.

69.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_064
69.description: I am also impressed with the offering of three flavors─a wise business decision that encourages repeated patronage.

70.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_065
70.description: Indeed, the entire enterprise of the Starlight Stalls is inspired. And in offering the chance for children to experience other cultures, it has attracted my interest─as an individual and a representative as the East Aldenard Trading Company both!

71.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_066
71.description: I beg your pardon, did you say “Namazu whisker”? Come now, that is surely a jest. I assume you are referring to some manner of ingredient that appears as a whisker—a strand of spice, mayhap.

73.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_068
73.description: When seeking to introduce a new specialty, I suppose uniqueness is a way to pierce a crowded market...

74.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_HANCOCK_000_069
74.description: Well, the drink has had quite an invigorating effect. So if you will excuse me, I shall continue to peruse the stalls.

75.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_070
75.description: What fortune to meet you here, my friend. I had heard tell of the festivities while attending to some matters abroad, and decided to make a detour and tour the stalls.

76.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_071
76.description: I must say, I also smell some familiar fragrances... If you are serving beverages to guests, then 'twould be improper not to accept. May I trouble you for a mug?

80.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_073
80.description: Ah, so you have used Hannish spices. It never fails to gladden me to see our produce being embraced in foreign lands.

81.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_074
81.description: And to see that, no matter where we hail from, we are united in the joy we find in festivals.

82.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_075
82.description: Perhaps I shall try to incorporate some aspects of Eorzean celebrations into our own. Yes, I believe it would make a fine gift to my people.

83.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_076
83.description: <chuckle> I see you have spared no spice in this drink, my friend. I was able to taste it even with this vessel.

84.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_077
84.description: ...I daresay Zero would enjoy it. They still serve her special curry at the meyhane on occasion. And when they do, it never fails to get lively.

85.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_VARSHAHN_000_078
85.description: But to return to the subject of the drink─do take care with the amount of spice. I expect the children here are no less inquisitive than those in Radz-at-Han, and may unknowingly bite off more than they can chew!

86.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_ERENVILLE_000_080
86.description: I happened to have an urgent request nearby, so I thought I'd visit the stalls...and who should I run into again but you. Well, seeing you serving punch is a new experience at least. I'll have an Ul'dahn one please.

90.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_ERENVILLE_000_082
90.description: Not bad, not bad. It's interesting to note that while the flora of Thanalan and Yyasulani bear many similarities, their cuisines have evolved rather differently.

91.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_ERENVILLE_000_083
91.description: Though my work for the guildship took me to all manner of places, I rarely had time to enjoy proper meals. As an independent contractor, I can allow myself to take in not only the sights at my destinations, but the tastes as well.

92.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_ERENVILLE_000_084
92.description: My thanks for the drink. I think I'll take a look around the Starlight Stalls and then go on a stroll through the forest. There is much to see and do!

95.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_ERENVILLE_000_087
95.description: Not you too, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>... They aren't entirely inedible, I concede, but putting them in a sweet drink? There are <hex:021A020203>limits<hex:021A020103>, for gods' sake.

96.name: TEXT_FESXMX2025OMAKE_00941_ERENVILLE_000_088
96.description: <sigh> When you travel the world, you truly encounter all kinds of things─and people. I suppose I owe you for that at least...
